statement: The fixed outer polygons are orthogonal in source coordinates; their complete vertex-coordinate grid makes each included source rectangle a filled subset. Every world inset corner is strictly inside every true transformed source edge by exact rational interval cross products, hence each whole convex world rectangle is contained. For a rectangle of width/height exceeding R-r, the original cog inner disk collision interval overlaps both support-tip collision intervals. With the center at least beta from the transverse sides, a support vertex with longitudinal projection >=h and absolute transverse projection <=beta lies in the rectangle. The union forbids longitudinal center coordinates strictly from low-h to high+h. Shrinking each strict box by1micrometre yields a closed, entirely forbidden rectangle. Cartesian edge partition and closed-cell retention cover every continuous feasible source center, including boundary cases; only cells wholly inside one proved forbidden box are removed. Flooring a feasible source center to1micrometre stays inside its retained integer-bound cell. No full source layout is claimed.
